title: Game telemetry
description: What Star Citizen says about your character and your ship, live, and the actions the app can trigger in game. Nothing leaves your PC, except what you ask Nexus Chat.

empty.disabled: Telemetry is disabled in the settings.
empty.waiting: The game is not running, or its telemetry is not enabled.
empty.noCharacter: Connected to the game. Data comes in as soon as a character is in game.

help.waiting: No telemetry service answers on 127.0.0.1:{port}. Start the game after enabling GameTelemetryEnabled.

events.title: Events
events.empty: No event since the app opened.

actions.title: Game actions
actions.hint: Each action runs on click. High-impact ones (eject, self-destruct, emergency exit, power or shields off, quantum drive, landing gear, opening the doors) ask for confirmation. For a held action, enter a duration in seconds.
actions.notConnected: Actions are available once the app is connected to the game.
actions.loadError: The list of actions could not be read.
actions.holdLabel: How long to hold {action}, in seconds
actions.confirmBody: This action has a strong effect in game. It will be triggered right away.

triggerStatus.unknownAction: The game does not know this action.
triggerStatus.rateLimited: Too many actions in a row, try again in a moment.
triggerStatus.failed: The game could not trigger the action.

errors.notConnected: The app is not connected to the game.
errors.gameRunning: Close Star Citizen first: it rewrites this file when it exits.
errors.unexpectedFile: attributes.xml is not shaped as expected: nothing was changed.
